headline: Sensex plunges 989 points as bears take charge; Nifty drops to 25,600 amid profit booking

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit booking by investors snapped the two-day rally in Indian stock markets.
Weakness in IT stocks dragged the key benchmark indices lower.
Bears took firm control as Sensex plunged nearly 989 points during the session.
Selling pressure was seen across major sectoral indices following recent market gains.
whatHappening: Sensex crashed 989 points to end at 25,600 while Nifty slipped below 25,650.
RBI reduced the daily CRR maintenance requirement to 90%, unlocking over ₹40,000 crore.
IT sector faced dragging pressure while metal stocks showed outperformance in early trade.
RBI Governor pegged AI's potential economic value for MSMEs at $685 billion.
summary: Indian benchmark indices witnessed a sharp sell-off on November 27, with the Sensex sinking 989 points and Nifty dropping to 25,600 due to profit booking and IT drag. Separately, the RBI announced a cut in daily CRR maintenance requirement to 90% to unlock over ₹40,000 crore. HDFC Bank remained in focus following recent strong market performance.
